rows.evidence: BotScoreBadge renders `✓ Real {score}/100` for any score ≥ 80. The score is BuyerLead.matchScore, computed at app/api/bots/buyerbot/[itemId]/route.ts:293-295 as `Math.round((75 + cls.confidence * 100) / 2)` — a hardcoded 75 baseline blended with lib/sylvia/gateway classify(), which is network-free and runs over the LLM's OWN emitted text (:286-289). Nothing verifies the person exists. Rule 1: displaying a confidence score the system never measured, and asserting a stranger is "Real" to a 70-year-old estate seller.
rows.replacement: Replace the verdict word with a provenance chip: "AI-suggested lead — unverified" · "Verify before contacting". Never assert Real/Bot.

rows.surface: Buyer Finder · How it works, step 4
rows.claim: Send with one click — all outreach is tracked and reply rates are measured automatically
rows.evidence: sendMessage() (:311-321) POSTs /api/buyers/outreach/[leadId]. That route (app/api/buyers/outreach/[leadId]/route.ts) does exactly three things: advanceFunnel → CONTACTED, prisma.conversation.create, prisma.message.create with sender "seller". It opens no socket to any platform, sends no email, calls no Graph API. Nothing leaves the database. "Reply rates" at :482 divide repliedCount by contactedCount, both derived from outreachStatus values only the seller can change — no buyer can ever move them.
rows.replacement: "Open the lead where you found it, paste your draft, and mark it contacted. Legacy-Loop tracks what you sent — it does not send for you."

rows.claim: Messages Sent … real outreach
rows.evidence: value = sentIds.size. sendMessage() wraps the POST in `.catch(() => null)` and then calls setSentIds in the `finally` block (:315-317) — the counter increments even when the request 404s, 403s (unsafe lead), or the network is down. And even on a 200 the route transmits nothing externally. The sub-label literally asserts "real outreach" for a number that measures clicks. Rule 1: showing "sent" for something that was never sent.
rows.replacement: Label: "Leads Opened" · sub: "you contacted these yourself". Only increment on res.ok.

rows.claim: ✓ Reached out · open again ↗

rows.replacement: :621 → "✓ Opened · open again ↗". :625 → "✓ Draft saved to your inbox".
